definitions.short: properly, fishery , i.e. a hook for fishing
definitions.full: H1729. dugah דּוּגָה noun feminine fishing, fishery , only in דּוּגָה בְּסִירוֺת וְנִשָּׂא Amos 4:2 (|| בְּצִנּוֺת ) of ׳י , metaphor for dragging Israel captive (compare for practice referred to, in case of fish, Ezek 29:4 & Job 40:26 scornful summons to do it with crocodile, if possible ! see Herod ii. 70 on mode of capturing crocodiles ).
